nameOrigin: insect/bacterium that feeds off another animal

pokedexEntries.rb: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

pokedexEntries.ye: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

pokedexEntries.go: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

pokedexEntries.si: As its body grows large, oriental mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

pokedexEntries.cr: The tochukaso growing on this POKéMON’s back orders it to extract juice from tree trunks.

pokedexEntries.ru: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from the BUG POKéMON host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.

pokedexEntries.sa: PARAS has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this BUG POKéMON host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.

pokedexEntries.fr: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

pokedexEntries.lg: Burrows to suck tree roots. The mushrooms on its back grow by drawing nutrients from the bug host.

pokedexEntries.em: A PARAS has parasitic tochukaso mushrooms growing on its back. They grow by drawing nutrients from the host. They are valued as a medicine for long life.

pokedexEntries.dpp: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host PARAS.

pokedexEntries.hg: It is doused with mushroom spores when it is born. As its body grows, mushrooms sprout from its back.

pokedexEntries.ss: As its body grows, large mushrooms named tochukaso start sprouting out of its back.

pokedexEntries.bw: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

pokedexEntries.x: Growing out of the bug’s back are mushrooms called tochukaso. The mushrooms grow with the bug host.

pokedexEntries.y: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

pokedexEntries.oras: Paras has parasitic mushrooms growing on its back called tochukaso. They grow large by drawing nutrients from this Bug Pokémon host. They are highly valued as a medicine for extending life.

pokedexEntries.su: No matter how much it eats, the mushrooms growing on its back steal away most of the nutrients it consumes.

pokedexEntries.mo: Mushrooms called tochukaso sprout from its back. They can be dried and powdered to make a medicine used to extend life.

pokedexEntries.us: Whether it’s due to a lack of moisture or a lack of nutrients, in Alola the mushrooms on Paras don’t grow up quite right.

pokedexEntries.um: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: Burrows under the ground to gnaw on tree roots. The mushrooms on its back absorb most of the nutrition.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

pokedexEntries.la: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.
